text: {"lessons":["Several months of falling account value showed me that holding without reviewing risk is not the same as having a plan; I should check whether my holdings still fit my need for stability.","Selling after sizable losses taught me not to make decisions based only on how far a price is below my cost or on recent declines; I should assess each holding's prospects and risk calmly.","As a retired investor who depends on these savings, I should keep trades measured and preserve a suitable balance of cash and stocks rather than make abrupt changes."]}
